text: "Whether [it be] for correction, or for His earth [generally] Or for [His] mercy and lovingkindness, He causes it to happen.
"So shall it be told Him that I wish to speak? Or should a man say that he would be swallowed up [and destroyed by God]?
"Men therefore fear Him; He does not regard nor respect any who are wise in heart [in their own understanding and conceit]."
